usage: The phrase is used to indicate that an action or change happens over a period of time, emphasizing a slow or steady process.
It can be placed before verbs or adjectives to modify the manner or pace of the action.
Often used in both positive and neutral contexts to describe natural progression or gentle encouragement.
It works well in storytelling or giving instructions, allowing the speaker to urge patience or careful progression.
Can be repeated for emphasis on the slowness or gradual nature of the event.
